value.rationale: For a concrete modern matrix-function refinement, the example separates local spectral contraction, fixed Loewner comparability and vanishing relative initial root error from norm-safe transient behavior and positivity preservation. Exact amplification and a finite-step indefiniteness threshold make a genuine basin-of-attraction limitation, rather than a textbook substitution or a numerical anecdote.
